verdict.rationale: Flagright documents HTTPS webhook delivery with an `X-Flagright-Signature` header on each event and secret rolling with an overlap window, which covers verifying event authenticity. Retries are documented for up to 3 days, but nothing in the pack shows a unique event ID, idempotency key, or deduplication guidance for retried deliveries, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented event ID or idempotency field for deduplicating retries, signature verification algorithm and replay/timestamp details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
